segments.he:
א.

עַל־יְדֵי גַבְהוּת הַלֵּב נוֹפֵל לִתְפִיסָה.
segments.en: Sometimes a person becomes afraid before some good comes to him.

segments.he:
ב.

דְּמוֹדֶה לְנָכְרִים נוֹפֵל בִּידֵיהוֹן, אֶלָּא כָּל דִּבְרֵיהֶם תִּסְתֹּר.
segments.en: Someone who flees from trouble is smart.

segments.he:
ג.

הָאוֹמֵר דָּבָר בְּשֵׁם אוֹמְרוֹ, מֵבִיא גְּאֻלָּה לָעוֹלָם.
segments.en: On a night that you have  fear while sleeping , do not go on the road in the day.

segments.he:
ד.

עַל־יְדֵי פִּדְיוֹן שְׁבוּיִים נִתְקַבֵּץ נִדָּחָיו שֶׁל הַפּוֹדֶה.
segments.en: When a person is on the verge of death, even if he is still healthy and does not know of his death sentence, nonetheless, he becomes afraid and says verbally that he will die.

segments.he:
ה.

מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ יוֹצֵא מִבֵּיתוֹ חָשׁוּב, כִּתְפִיסָה.
segments.en: Through haughtiness of the heart, one falls into incarceration.

segments.he:
ו.

בַּעֲווֹן מִשְׁכַּב־זָכָר נִתְפָּס בִּתְפִיסָה.
segments.en: One who agrees with the non-Jews falls into their hands. Rather, one should contradict all of their words.

segments.he:
ז.

מִי שֶׁמְּרַחֵם עַל הַשְּׁבוּיִים, הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מַצִּילוֹ מִמִּיתָה.
segments.en: Someone who says a statement in the name of the one who said it  (originator) , brings redemption to the world.

segments.he:
ח.

מִי שֶׁהוּא בִּתְפִיסָה, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁגַּם נִשְׁמָתוֹ לְמַעְלָה בִּתְפִיסָה.
segments.en: Through redeeming prisoners, the redeemer's dispersed are gathered.

segments.he:
ט.

מִי שֶׁבָּא לַצַּדִּיק וְשׁוֹאֵל אֶת הַצַּדִּיק עֵצָה וּמֵפֵר עֲצָתוֹ אַחַר־כָּךְ, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה נִתְפָּס בִּתְפִיסָה.
segments.en: Someone who does not leave his house is considered as if incarcerated.

segments.he:
י.

מִי שֶׁמַּאֲכִיל לֶחֶם לָרְעֵבִים, הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מַצִּיל אוֹתוֹ מִבֵּית־הָאֲסוּרִים.
segments.en: Through the sin of homosexuality, one becomes incarcerated.

segments.he:
יא.

מִי שֶׁלֹּא תִּקֵּן חַטְּאוֹת נְעוּרִים, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה בָּא לְבֵית־הָאֲסוּרִים.

יב.

מִי שֶׁהוּא רָגִיל לִהְיוֹת מוֹהֵל, אוֹ לְסַפֵּק צָרְכֵי סְעוּדַת בְּרִית־מִילָה שֶׁל עָנִי, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה נִצּוֹל מִבֵּית־הָאֲסוּרִים.
חלק שני
segments.en: Part Two

segments.he:
א.

עַל־יְדֵי  נִאוּף נוֹפֵל לִתְפִיסָה אוֹ ל ְ חֳלִי כְּאֵב רַגְלַיִם. גַּם תַּלְמִיד שֶׁלֹּא הִגִּיעַ לְהוֹרָאָה וּמוֹרֶה, נוֹפֵל לָזֶה, גַּם מַזִּיקִין שׁוֹלְטִין עָלָיו.
segments.en: Someone who has mercy on prisoners, the Holy One, Blessed be He, saves him from death.

segments.he:
ב.

סְגֻלַּת הַצְּדָקָה לְבַטֵּל כָּל אֵלּוּ הָעֳנָשִׁים.
segments.en: Someone who is incarcerated, it is certain that his soul above is also incarcerated.

segments.he:
ג.

בִּשְׁבִיל שֶׁאֵין מְבַקְשִׁין רַחֲמִים עַל חֲבֵרוֹ, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה נוֹפֵל לִתְפִיסָה, וְתִקּוּן לִתְפִיסָה, שֶׁיְּפַרְנֵס אֵיזֶהוּ בַּעֲלֵי־חַיִּים.
segments.en: Someone who comes to the Tzadik and asks the Tzadik advice, and afterwards violates his advice, as a result, he becomes incarcerated.

segments.he:
ד.

עַל־יְדֵי תַּשְׁמִישׁ הַמִּטָּה בְּיָמִים שֶׁאֲסוּרִין בְּתַשְׁמִישׁ, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה נוֹפֵל לִתְפִיסָה.
segments.en: One who feeds bread to the hungry, the Holy One, Blessed be He, saves him from the jailhouse.

segments.he:
ה.

כְּשֶׁאֶחָד מִבְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל נִתְפַּס בִּתְפִיסָה, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה לְפִי בְּחִינָתוֹ נִסְתְּמוּ מַעַיְנוֹת הַחָכְמָה מֵחַכְמֵי הַדּוֹר, וּלְהֵפֶךְ כְּשֶׁיוֹצֵא מֵהַתְּפִיסָה.
segments.en: One who did not fix the sins of his youth, as a result, he goes to the jail house.

segments.he:
ו.

לִפְעָמִים עַל־יְדֵי תְּפִיסָה נִצּוֹל מִכִּלְיוֹן בָּנִים.
segments.en: Someone who is accustomed to performing circumcisions, or providing for the expenses of the circumcision feast for a poor person, through this, he is saved from the jail house.

segments.he:
ז.

עַל־יְדֵי לָשׁוֹן הָרָע נִתְפָּס בִּתְפִיסָה.
segments.en: Through lewdness, one falls into incarceration or foot pain sickness. Also, a student who had not reached the level of delivering a halachic directive, yet prescribes, falls into this. Als o, damaging spirits rule over  (afflict)  him.

segments.he:
ח.

הַשְּׂעָרוֹת שֶׁגְּדֵלִין עַל הָאָדָם וְהַמַּלְבּוּשִׁים שֶׁעַל הָאָדָם בְּשָׁעָה שֶׁיּוֹשֵׁב בִּתְפִיסָה, שׁוֹרֶה עֲלֵיהֶם רוּחַ מְכֹעָר, שׁ ֶעוֹכ ֵ ר וּמְבַזֶּה אֶת הָאָדָם.
segments.en: Charity is a  segulah (conductive)  to nullifying all of those punishments.

segments.he:
ט.

הִשְׁתַּדְּלוּת בְּפִדְיוֹן שְׁבוּיִים מְסֻגָּל לְהוֹלָדָה.
segments.en: Due to not requesting compassion on behalf of one's friend, as a result, one falls into incarceration. And a remedy for incarceration is to support some living creature.

segments.he:
י.

מִי שֶׁעוֹסֵק בְּפִדְיוֹן שְׁבוּיִים, גְּדוֹלֵי הַדּוֹר נִכְלָלִים בּוֹ עַל־יְדֵי זֶה.
segments.en: Through having marital relations on days on which such relations are forbidden, through this one falls into incarceration.

When one of the children of Israel falls into incarceration, as a result, according to his aspect, the wellsprings of wisdom are sealed up from the wise of the generation, and the opposite is true when he is freed from incarceration.
Sometimes, through incarceration, one is saved from loss of children.
Through  lushon hura (slander) , one becomes incarcerated.
The hairs that grow on a person and the clothes on a person at the time that he sits in captivity, an ugly spirit rests upon them which makes a person ugly and degraded.
Making an effort to free prisoners is a  segulah (conducive)  for child-bearing.
Someone who is involved in freeing prisoners, through this, the great ones of the generation are included in him.
